recentItems.title: Widow’s Bay Season 2: Everything Matthew Rhys & More Have Teased | E! News
recentItems.description:
Widow's Bay, nominated for a staggering 19 Emmy nominations, has been renewed for season two. As for how the Widow's Bay team is responding to all the love? "I think genuine shock on behalf of all of us as a cast and relief," Rhys, who plays Widow's Bay Mayor Tom Loftis, recently told E! News. "There was concern about what the tone would be and whether an audience would get it, embrace it, like it." Creator and showrunner Katie Dippold revealed this summer to Deadline that the crew headed back to the writers room and that coming up for ideas for season two has been easier than the first. She revealed during a panel August 16, “Week three and feeling great. I’m still happy they all signed up. It’s a tough pitch. I feel like a lot of groundwork was laid in season one so you can buy it. So, it’s making season two much more fun.”

recentItems.title: Paradise Star Krys Marshall Reveals Her Low-Maintenance Prep for Emmys | E! News
recentItems.description:
Krys Marshall knows what it takes to get camera-ready. And now, the ‘Paradise’ star, who portrays Secret Service Special Agent Nicole Robinson in the hit Hulu series, up for Outstanding Drama Series at the 2026 Emmys, is sharing a glimpse into her relatable beauty routine for the 2026 Emmys on Sept. 14. "I try to drink a lot of water and just make sure that I'm really well hydrated," Marshall exclusively told E! News' Erim Lim Rhodes, also noting that she didn't need a med spa appointment since she is "not a Botox or filler girlie." She explained, "I don't do things that maybe some other folks do, but for me, it's mostly just facials, trying to get some good rest.”

recentItems.title: Inside Jenna Ortega’s Goth-Glam Style Evolution | E! News
recentItems.description:
Inside Jenna Ortega’s goth-glam fashion evolution: from a lace-veiled Versace gown to her heavy, bejeweled Givenchy look at the 2025 Emmy Awards. The 23-year-old Wednesday star brought delicate florals to her first Emmys as a nominee in a strapless Dior Couture gown, then delivered bold looks including a custom red tulle Dior dress at the 2024 Beetlejuice Beetlejuice Venice premiere and Balmain’s metallic ruler gown at the 2025 Met Gala. At the 2025 Emmys, Ortega paired a black skirt with a Givenchy top made of oversized multicolored jewels cascading across her torso—an ensemble her stylist Enrique Melendez later told the Plus One podcast weighed “like a good 20, 30 pounds, at least.” The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, hosted by Mariska Hargitay, airs live on NBC Sept. 14 at 8 p.m. ET / 5 p.m. PT.
